category.description: Case category from the catalog (memory/transport/execution/collective/compute/overlap). Written when the record is created, so a failed task keeps it.

ep_size.description: EP size this task was planned at, so a report never has to re-derive it from the config of a failed record.

case_parameters.description: The standard parameter field: the planned case parameters (variant, message_bytes, mechanism, ...). The legacy `parameters` key is only read, never written.

parameters.description: Legacy alias of case_parameters, read for backwards compatibility and never written by the current code.

observation.description: What actually ran: actual_api, actual_algorithm, actual_transport, fallback state, the four byte kinds (logical/remote/measured_wire/local_copy), per-rank latency, source and confidence. See common/observation.py.

completion.description: The completion guarantee the measurement has: level (submitted/fenced/local_complete/remote_visible), detail, proves_transfer. A fenced sample must not be reported as a completed transfer.

handler.description: The CaseSpec handler that executed this task.
